htn_kidney.title: NLRP3 Inflammasome Activation and Atherogenic Lipid Profile in Hemodialysis Patients.
htn_kidney.journal: Therapeutic apheresis and dialysis : official peer-reviewed journal of the International Society for Apheresis, the Japanese Society for Apheresis, the Japanese Society for Dialysis Therapy
htn_kidney.authors: Abdelaziz MN, Elshabrawy N, Almenshawy A
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：NOD 样受体家族含热蛋白结构域 3 (NLRP3) 炎性体是一种重要的先天免疫调节剂，与心血管疾病的发展有关。然而研究人员尚未有效研究它与致动脉粥样硬化的嘴唇的关系 临床提示：接受血液透析治疗的终末期肾病（ESRD）患者会加速动脉粥样硬化的发展，其主要原因有两个：致动脉粥样硬化性血脂异常和慢性炎症。
htn_kidney.abstract: End-stage renal disease (ESRD) patients who undergo hemodialysis treatment experience accelerated atherosclerosis development, which results from two main causes: atherogenic dyslipidemia and chronic inflammation. The NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome, which serves as an essential innate immunity regulator, has links to cardiovascular disease development; yet researchers have not effectively studied its connection to atherogenic lipid profiles among dialysis patients. This study examined the association between NLRP3 inflammasome levels and the atherogenic index of plasma (AIP) in hemodialysis patients. This study at Mansoura University Hospital focused ...

portal_hypertension.title: Incidence and implications of abstinence-induced recompensation in alcohol-related cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hofer BS, Tonon M, Buttler L
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于多中心临床研究（样本量约为 633）。核心观点：本研究调查了禁欲引起的补偿的发生率、预测因素和影响。 临床提示：戒酒可以使失代偿性酒精相关性肝硬化患者进行肝脏再代偿。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Alcohol abstinence enables hepatic recompensation in patients with decompensated alcohol-related cirrhosis. This study investigated the incidence, predictors, and impact of abstinence-induced recompensation. This multicentre study included patients with decompensated alcohol-related cirrhosis recruited at the time of abstinence up to December 2022. Recompensation was defined by Baveno VII criteria: (i) sustained abstinence (≥3 months), (ii) resolution of ascites and hepatic encephalopathy off therapy, (iii) absence of variceal bleeding for 1 year, and (iv) restored liver function (Child-Pugh A or MELD <10).
